intent: Write the test for EventRecord (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/eventlog/domain/EventRecord.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Event Revision record of the append-only Telemetry Event Log: the persisted sample, its revision number (assigned by the repository, increasing per device/metric/tDevice key) and kind (RECORD for the first record of a key, REVISION for each later corrective or backfilled frame). Public String constants KIND_RECORD="RECORD", KIND_REVISION="REVISION". TEST DUTIES: Assert accessors, equality and the kind constants.

methods.signature: EventRecord(TelemetrySample sample, int revision, String kind)
